captions.instagram:
We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites with Google’s lab test, on a simulated mid-range phone.

The median Squarespace and Shopify sites took 11.1 seconds to show their main content. WordPress took 7.4 and Wix 6.6. Google calls 2.5 seconds good.

47.2% of Squarespace sites and 45.9% of Shopify sites scored poor.

The platform is not the whole story, though. What sits on the homepage matters on all of them.

captions.linkedin:
We ran Google Lighthouse on 12,621 Australian small-business websites, one mobile run each on a simulated mid-range phone.

Median time to show the main content, by platform:
Shopify 11.1 s
Squarespace 11.1 s
Webflow 8.4 s
WordPress 7.4 s
Wix 6.6 s

Google’s good mark is 2.5 seconds. 47.2% of Squarespace sites and 45.9% of Shopify sites scored poor, under 50 out of 100.

Two caveats. It is a lab test and deliberately tough, so read it as a warning light, not what every visitor sees. And the platform is detected from each site’s code, so it is a strong guess rather than a census.

The platform is not the whole story either. Full-size photos, apps and widgets on the homepage slow a site down on any of them.

Full method: prycedigital.com/research
